---
title: "Bare Stage"
---

## The stage with no theme {#bare-content}

This deck loads the slide-stage format extension and nothing else. It exists to
prove the extension carries no branding of its own: the rail and the title
artwork are theme hooks, and with no theme layer they resolve to `transparent`
and `none`.

The geometry, however, has to come out identical to a themed deck, which is
what the accompanying test asserts.

## A slide footer {#bare-footer}

A parenthetical note or a reference belongs along the bottom of the slide, in
type small enough to stay out of the way and large enough to read.

::: footer
Source: a reference given in passing, not part of the argument.
:::

## A slide without a footer {#bare-no-footer}

Between two footed slides, so moving through it shows whether the previous
slide's footer is cleared.

## A second slide footer {#bare-footer-2}

A different footer, which must replace the first rather than stack on it.

::: footer
Source: a second reference.
:::

## Punctuation after inline maths {#bare-math-punct}

Each day, measure staff, $\mathsf{N}\bigl(\mu_1, 10^2\bigr)$, and students, $\mathsf{N}\bigl(\mu_2, 9.5^2\bigr)$.
